signature.one_line: Phone meme: quoted ironic claim over deadpan selfie, then held three-line reality set-up.
unique_devices: Quoted one-line ironic claim in thin white sans at 26 % H over a deadpan front-camera selfie
Hard swap on the first cut to a 3-line centred set-up + native emoji at 17-28 % H, held unchanged across all remaining shots
No captions, no graphics, no grade: ungraded handheld phone footage, all cuts on audio pauses
Ends on a small human reaction shot (quiet smile) instead of a CTA
signature.why_it_works: Viewers recognise the gap between the claim and reality instantly; the deadpan face and held text let the footage tell the joke.

hook.first_frame: front-camera selfie of one person in a vehicle, deadpan look off camera, small white quoted line centred at ~26 % height

structure.what: deadpan selfie under the quoted ironic claim
text swaps to the 'reality' set-up; handheld walk-through of a crowded venue, then a packed corridor
side-profile reaction shot of the subject waiting, small smile; text still held

background_text.how: one line in curly quotes, thin geometric sans 54 px white, centred, ink centre y 26 %, ~47 % W; on from frame 0, no motion
3 centred lines, block y 17-27.7 %, line pitch 4.2 % H, widest line ~53 % W, same type; hard swap on the cut, held screen-fixed over 3 shots

broll_inserts.how: walking POV through a crowd, then a crowded corridor; raw phone look

layout.how: text confined to the upper 17-28 % band so faces stay clear

camera.how: selfie MCU, walking track, near-static profile; no punch-ins or stabilised moves

transitions.how: 3 of 3 cuts on pauses; pace speeds up toward the end

other_text_spec.type: meme-text overlays (no speech captions; these are the only text)

spec.script: latin (English on-screen text; any speech is a few ambient words, not captioned)
spec.punctuation: curly double quotes around the ironic claim; no full stops
spec.emoji: one native colour emoji (e.g. smiling face with tear) at the end of the set-up line, same size as the text

grouping.sync: not tied to speech: text swaps exactly on the first shot cut (~28 % of runtime)
grouping.break: balanced centred line breaks (~17 / 19 / 10 characters + emoji)

layout.note: upper third, clear of the subject's face; the set-up block is held across the last 3 shots (~28-100 % of runtime)

meme_text.font_class: geometric sans, light/regular (single-storey a and g, straight-tail y, round o)

closest_match.note: Poppins 500 matches the measured proportions but is heavier and has a two-storey a; the original is lighter (~300-400)
closest_match.web_font: a light geometric sans with single-storey a (Urbanist Regular) or Poppins Light 300

animation.entry: hard cut in, swapped exactly on the shot cut (1 frame); no fade, no scale, no typewriter
animation.exit: the first text hard-cuts to the second at the cut; the second holds to the end (~72 % of runtime, across three shots)
animation.idle: no motion; screen-fixed over handheld footage

other_text_spec.text: no titles, lower-thirds, logos, watermark or end card

meme_text.closest_local: Poppins 500 (or a lighter 300-400 geometric with single-storey a)

style.look_intent: high-contrast, muted, warm; ungraded phone daylight with sun streaks, natural skin

sound.music: music bed likely (heuristic, ~120 BPM estimate) under a few ambient words; trending-audio feel
sfx: none; cuts sit on pauses, not on beats (measured cut_hit_share 0.0)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: a relatable 'what people think vs what it is really like' joke about a job or industry
only raw phone footage is available, no presenter speaking
the post is meant to be shared as a meme, not to teach
avoid_when: there is a spoken explanation to caption
the brand needs logos, CTAs or polished graphics
the reality footage is not instantly readable without words
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B22 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B22.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship — text and accent must stay >= 4.5:1 / >= 3:1 against what sits behind them on the footage):
- {{TEXT}}      default #FFFFFF (meme text)
- {{ACCENT}}    default #FFFFFF (no accent colour in this style; keep it white unless the brand insists)
- {{ACCENT_2}}  default none
- {{SURFACE}}   default none (text sits directly on footage)
- {{CARD_BG}}   default none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} default Poppins 500 (a lighter 300-400 geometric with single-storey a is closer)
- {{FONT_BODY}}    default same as display
- {{HANDLE}}    default @handle
- {{LOGO}}      default the brand's logo file (transparent PNG/SVG)
Text must stay >= 4.5:1 on the footage behind the 17-28 % band; pick shots with a darker upper third rather than adding a box.
Canvas 1080x1920, sizes are px at that canvas; frame counts at 30 fps.

CAPTIONS
1. No speech captions. The only text is two meme-text overlays in a native in-app text look.
2. Overlay 1 (ironic claim, over the hook shot, ~28 % of runtime): one line in curly double quotes, sentence case (placeholder '“Headline here”'), {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 54 px, {{TEXT}}, centred, ink centre at 26 % H.
3. Overlay 2 (the reality, from the first cut to the end, held across every following shot): 3 centred lines, sentence case, balanced breaks, ending in one native emoji (placeholder 'Set-up line here / lead words KEY WORD / closing words <emoji>'). Block 17-27.7 % H, line pitch 4.2 % H (line-height ~1.25), widest line ~53 % W.
4. Type: {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 54 px, {{TEXT}}, tracking 0, no stroke / shadow / box; emoji at text size.
5. Animation: none. Overlay 1 on from frame 0; swapped for overlay 2 by hard cut exactly on the first shot cut; text never moves, fades or scales.

OTHER TEXT
6. None: no titles, {{LOGO}}, watermark or end card (add {{HANDLE}} only if the brand requires it, small, bottom-centre, outside the 17-28 % band).
7. Edit: 3-5 handheld phone shots, hard cuts on audio pauses, end on a quiet reaction shot (~25 % of runtime). Trend audio / music bed, no SFX.

GRADE
Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: high-contrast, muted, warm; ungraded-phone daylight, natural skin.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render overlay 1 and overlay 2 with the placeholders and measure:
   python3 video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test-render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.2,0.235,0.8,0.28 --ink "{{TEXT}}:45"
   python3 video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test-render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.15,0.16,0.85,0.30 --ink "{{TEXT}}:45"
b) python3 video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "Poppins 500" --word "<your line>" --ink 2.97 -> ~54-55 px for a line with ascenders and descenders; widest set-up line must stay <= ~53 % W (read at_verified_px). Line tops ~4.2 % H apart. Measure over mid/dark background. (fit_font.py needs a target: --ink and/or --width; it returns the px that reproduces that ink for YOUR word plus the width it will read at that px. Requires Pillow.)
c) Positions within ±1 % H: overlay 1 centre 26 %, overlay 2 block 17-27.7 %.
